resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org, firelookout.com and Willhite say the tower was gone by the 1950s, but a July 26, 1951 item quoted on Forest Lookouts still refers to the McMurray lookout station that year. The removal date is not known; the story says so.

Forest Lookouts lists the site as M C MURRAY (ENGLISH) and quotes a 1930 English Lookout report. Willhite suggests a link to timber owner Edward English but says no known lookout in the area has that name. The identification is unproven.

notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing: no staffing list, no removal date and no description of remains. The English Lookout link is unproven and the story says so. The brief's 426.7 m elevation matches firetower.org's 1,400 ft. Willhite's photo captions are not quoted. No photos added. Access is restricted per Willhite's undated write-up (fee and waiver); check the tree farm's current rules before publishing.
